subject: Spec: Timer display state machine + warning threshold
body:
## Problem
The timer displays remaining time (PASS). However, there is no documented or implemented visual warning state when time is running low. Kai needs a heads-up before time expires — not just a cutoff.

## Behavior

### State Machine: Timer Display

States:
- RUNNING: Full time remaining. Normal color. No urgency.
- WARNING: <= 30 seconds remaining. Amber color change + aria-live update.
- CRITICAL: <= 10 seconds remaining. Red color + subtle pulse.
- EXPIRED: 0 seconds. Timer stops. Exam auto-submits if unanswered.

Transitions:
- RUNNING -> WARNING: when secondsRemaining <= 30
- WARNING -> CRITICAL: when secondsRemaining <= 10
- CRITICAL -> EXPIRED: when secondsRemaining === 0
- Any state -> RUNNING: on exam reset/restart

## Visual Spec

### RUNNING state
- Color: `var(--text-secondary)`
- No animation

### WARNING state (<=30s)
- Color: `#B45309` (amber-700, 4.5:1+ on dark)
- aria-live="polite" update: "30 seconds remaining"
- No animation (ADHD: animation at this moment increases anxiety, not focus)

### CRITICAL state (<=10s)
- Color: `var(--color-incorrect)` (`#DC2626`)
- `animation: timer-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite` (reduced-motion guard: no animation)
- aria-live="assertive" update: "10 seconds remaining"

### EXPIRED state
- Timer shows 0:00
- Message: "Time's up! Let's see your score."
- Auto-advance to scorecard after 1500ms

## CSS Additions

```css
@keyframes timer-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.6; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .timer-critical { animation: none; }
}
```

## Copy
- Warning aria: "30 seconds remaining"
- Critical aria: "10 seconds remaining"
- Expired: "Time's up! Let's see your score."

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Timer shows remaining time (already done)
2. At <=30s: color changes to amber, aria-live="polite" fires once
3. At <=10s: color changes to red, aria-live="assertive" fires once
4. Critical animation has prefers-reduced-motion guard
5. Expired state advances to scorecard at 1500ms
6. No raw hex for amber — use CSS variable or define token

## What NOT to change
- Timer format (MM:SS)
- Timer position
- Exam auto-submit logic on expiry (if already implemented)

## Scope
- exam.html timer only
- shared/scripts.js timer countdown function
- shared/styles.css: add timer-warning and timer-critical classes

## Related
- da-23: Timer audit (PASS on remaining vs elapsed; WARNING state not present)
- .design-system.md Section 19 (animation standards)
